name: 2025-11-26 - October 2025 PFAS Sample Results Transmittal.pdf
type: PFAS results transmittal and analytical package
description: EGLE email transmittal dated November 26, 2025 for the October 22 Cadillac WWTP effluent sample, followed by the laboratory report and structured-data export. The analytical attachments overlap the canonical lab and DMR records already preserved, but the cover communication is distinct and states that the results complied with the five PFAS having Water Quality Values.

name: 2018-12-19 - IPP PFAS Sampling Guidance and Suggested Analytes.pdf
description: Six-page City/DEQ email thread from June through December 2018 concerning IPP PFAS source sampling. DEQ states that only PFOS and PFOA were required for probable-source monitoring while the broader analyte list was recommended, discusses modified Method 537 and ASTM D7979, and advises including percent solids for biosolids reporting. City staff identify landfill leachate as their IPP probable source in the correspondence.

name: 2018-04-19 - PFAS Extension and Landfill Sampling Correspondence.pdf
description: April 18-19, 2018 City/DEQ email exchange and embedded follow-up package. The correspondence clarifies that a May 8 extension request could accommodate landfill participation in DEQ's sampling program and that probable-source results were otherwise due June 29. The embedded agency letter overlaps the established April 18 timeline source; the direct clarification exchange is retained as distinct correspondence.

name: 2018-12-12 - PFAS Results Transmittal with Avon and WWTP Reports.pdf
description: December 12, 2018 City-to-DEQ email transmittal following a voicemail exchange, with the 22-page Avon-source report and 21-page Cadillac WWTP effluent report attached. The laboratory attachments overlap the canonical J18036-1 and J17993-1 records already preserved; this package is retained once for its delivery correspondence and attachment context.

name: 2018-09-20 - PFAS Interim Report Follow-Up Questions and City Response.pdf
description: August 27 through September 20, 2018 City/DEQ review thread. DEQ asks Cadillac to verify potential PFAS pathways at AAR, Rec Boat, Michigan Rubber Products, Avon Automotive, ARVCO and Hutchinson; Cadillac answers the six questions and provides supporting material, and DEQ acknowledges receipt for continued review.

name: 2018-11-01 - Avon PFAS Sampling Direction and Landfill Follow-Up.pdf
description: November 1, 2018 City/DEQ follow-up extending the interim-review thread. DEQ directs PFAS sampling at Avon Automotive based on the reviewed Dyneon information, asks for the sampling schedule, seeks clarification on Rec Boat process wastewater and records continued landfill evaluation. Cadillac's inline response says bottles were ordered and describes the Rec Boat and landfill status.

name: 2018-06-15 - Cadillac WWTP CSI Final Report Transmittal.msg
description: Native June 15, 2018 MDEQ email transmitting the final Cadillac WWTP compliance sampling inspection report for review, MiWaters upload and delivery to the facility. The attached eight-sheet workbook is preserved separately as its original editable source; the exact official MiEnviro PDF rendition is preserved in the compliance library. Instructions inside the email are retained only as historical record content.

name: 2018-09-20 - Chlorine and UV Disinfection Inquiry Correspondence.pdf
description: Three-page January-through-September 2018 City/MDEQ email chain about Cadillac WWTP disinfection equipment and outdated process diagrams. On September 20, City staff state that UV had completely replaced chlorine, that the obsolete chlorine and sulfur-dioxide equipment had been removed, and that the available flow diagram remained unchanged except for those systems. The correspondence documents the City's process-configuration representation; it contains no PFAS analytical result, leachate delivery record, treatment-effectiveness measurement or source-to-receptor pathway evidence.
